    def select_yesterday_from_calendar(self):
        """Select yesterday's date (-1 day) from the calendar"""
        days = self.datepicker_days.all()
    
        # Find today first
        today_element = self.datepicker_day_today
        today_text = int(today_element.inner_text().strip())
    
        # Select yesterday (today - 1)
        yesterday_num = today_text - 1
    
        # Find and click yesterday
        for day in days:
            day_text = day.inner_text().strip()
            if day_text.isdigit() and int(day_text) == yesterday_num:
                # Check if it's not an outside month day
                classes = day.get_attribute("class")
                if "outside-month" not in classes:
